source_elements_verbatim: [EP06_EL093 | 07:19.10-07:22.40] **:** The Joker leans in, pressing his head to the gun's barrel.

I just did what I do best- I took your plan, and I turned it on itself. Look what I've done to this city with a few drums of gas and a couple of bullets.  Nobody panics when the expected people get killed.  Nobody panics when things go according to plan, even if the plan is horrifying. If I tell the press that tomorrow a gangbanger will get shot, or a truckload of soldiers will be blown up, nobody panics.  Because it's all part of the plan.  But when I say that one little old mayor will die, everybody loses their minds! Introduce a little anarchy, you upset the established order and everything becomes chaos.  I'm an agent of chaos.  And you know the thing about chaos, Harvey? Dent looks into the Joker's eyes.  Finding meaning.

objects_and_clues.significance: A coin with two identical heads used by Dent to prove he makes his own luck; its scarred second face later mirrors his transformation into Two-Face.
Batman's tagged currency fed into Gotham mob banks that allows the MCU and Dent to coordinate a sweeping RICO prosecution.
The Joker's signature calling card left at crime scenes, carrying victim DNA and terroristic threats.
An escape motorcycle formed directly from the Tumbler's front wheels and axle after self-destructing.
A detonator sewn into a henchman's abdomen used by the Joker to blast his way out of MCU holding and recapture Lau.
A confession letter from Rachel stating she will marry Dent because Bruce will never stop being Batman; concealed by Alfred to preserve Bruce's sanity.
Burned on one side, it serves as Dent's absolute moral arbiter to decide life or death for his targets.
Used by the Joker to demolish Gotham General Hospital after disguised infiltration.
Wayne Enterprises high-frequency generator that maps Gotham City via every personal mobile phone.
Cruel social experiment tools giving each ferry the power to detonate the other boat to save themselves.
Letter revealing Rachel's choice of Harvey, burned by Alfred to preserve Bruce Wayne's faith.

relationships.relation: Allies fighting organized crime, with Bruce believing Dent can become the legitimate white knight Gotham needs so Batman can retire.
Inextricably linked philosophical adversaries representing absolute moral order versus unrelenting chaos and nihilism.
Romantic partners and legal crusaders; Rachel accepts Harvey's marriage proposal moments before her death.
Lifelong friends and former lovers; Bruce believes she will return to him once his Batman crusade concludes.
Distrustful allies whose partnership collapses into vengeful hatred after corrupt officers in Gordon's squad allow Rachel's abduction.
Partners in Wayne Enterprises; Fox serves as Batman's master armorer and tactical conscience.
Former allies turned bitter enemies as Two-Face blames Gordon's toleration of corrupt unit detectives for Rachel's death.
Philosophical mirror opposites: the incorruptible protector versus the agent of nihilistic moral collapse.
Trusted corporate and technical partners whose bond fractures over mass surveillance ethics.
Batman believed Dent was Gotham's true legal savior, ultimately taking the fall for Dent's descent into madness.

episode_summaries.summary: The Joker pulls off a coordinated mob bank heist, while Batman, Lieutenant Gordon, and new District Attorney Harvey Dent unite to seize the mafia's pooled money.
The Joker gatecrashes a mob meeting offering to kill Batman, while Batman executes a daring skyhook extraction in Hong Kong to bring money launderer Lau to justice.
Dent uses Lau to arrest over 500 mobsters, provoking the Joker to launch an assassination spree against Gotham city officials and attack Bruce Wayne's penthouse.
After Gordon is seemingly killed during a parade attack on the Mayor, Dent publicly claims to be Batman to lure out the Joker, triggering an explosive street convoy pursuit.
Gordon returns from the dead to capture the Joker, but the clown manipulates his interrogation into a trap that murders Rachel and transforms Dent into Two-Face.
The Joker burns the mob's billions, threatens hospitals to trigger a citywide manhunt for Reese, and sways a disfigured Harvey Dent toward chaos while rigging two evacuation ferries with explosives.

Both ferries refuse to detonate each other, Batman captures the Joker, and then Batman sacrifices his own reputation to cover up Two-Face's murderous rampage, fleeing into the night as the Dark Knight.
